name: project-workflow
description: A delivery workflow for complex software engineering in Codex, with repository-persisted evidence, scoped execution, recovery, validation, and optional native multi-agent collaboration.

interface.shortDescription: Reliable delivery workflows for complex Codex engineering.
interface.longDescription: Project Workflow persists design, implementation, verification, and delivery evidence in the repository, keeps changes scoped, supports interruption recovery and task retry, and enables native multi-agent collaboration when it provides a measurable benefit. An explicit approval gate controls the transition from plan to execution, with validation and conditional rollback checks based on task risk.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Project Workflow for this complex software task: create a durable plan, wait for my explicit approval, then execute the approved scope with scoped validation and coordinator or native-agent orchestration when beneficial.
